$comment: Mechanical checks for `write-like-a-human lint`. Edit freely. Turn any rule off by adding its id to `disabled`. Regex rules default to case-insensitive.

rules.message: Em-dash. Use a period, a comma, or a spaced hyphen.
Generic AI vocabulary. Say what actually happens.
Intensifier with no particular behind it. Cut it or replace it with the fact.
"not X, but Y" scaffolding. State the positive claim and stop.
"not X, it's Y" scaffolding. State the positive claim and stop.
Contrast phrase. Check whether the positive claim stands alone.

rules.pattern: (?<=^|[.!?]["’”)]?\s+)(?:in today['’]s|in a world where|in an era of|let['’]s be honest|here['’]s the thing|i hope this (?:email|message|note) finds you well|i wanted to reach out|i['’]m reaching out|i am reaching out|it['’]s no secret|it goes without saying|as we all know)\b
rules.message: Throat-clearing opener. Start on the first sentence that carries information.

rules.pattern: \b(?:the real (?:problem|question|issue|challenge) (?:is|was)|the truth is|make no mistake|let me be clear|it['’]s worth noting|it is worth noting|needless to say)\b
(?<=^|[.!?]["’”)]?\s+)(?:in short|in summary|in conclusion|to sum up|ultimately|at the end of the day|all in all|the bottom line is)\b
rules.message: Restating closer. If the point already landed, delete the sentence.
